comment: Byte fixtures for the Reticulum-over-RNode dissector, extracted from the firmware C++ tests. Entries marked 'constructed' were built from the flag layout in src/core/reticulum_decoder.cpp because no C++ test pins those exact bytes. 'expect' keys compare against ReticulumDissection fields and 'expectAnnounce' keys against fields.announce (the semantic announce tier, readReticulumAnnounce in src/core/reticulum_decoder.cpp); hex strings compare as numbers. The announce-* entries follow buildAnnounceFrame in test/reticulum_announce/test_reticulum_announce.cpp byte for byte, including its region ramps: transport id 0x70+, destination hash 0xd0+, public key 0x11+, name hash 0x21+, random hash 0x31+, ratchet 0x41+, signature 0x51+, app_data 0x61+ — so a copy from the wrong offset cannot pass.

fixtures.name: announce-payload-too-short
fixtures.source: constructed — HEADER_1 SINGLE/ANNOUNCE flags (0x01) per the masks in src/core/reticulum_decoder.cpp; announces are cleartext by protocol rule (payloadIsClear), but a 4-byte payload cannot hold the 148-byte fixed announce layout, so announceArithmeticHolds fails and the frame stays structural (header-only, no announce)

fixtures.name: link-request
fixtures.source: constructed — HEADER_1 SINGLE/LINK REQUEST flags (0x02); link requests are cleartext by protocol rule (payloadIsClear in src/core/reticulum_decoder.cpp)

fixtures.name: proof-resource-proof-context
fixtures.source: constructed — HEADER_1 SINGLE/PROOF flags (0x03) with context 0x05 (RESOURCE PROOF), which payloadIsClear in src/core/reticulum_decoder.cpp treats as cleartext

fixtures.name: announce-printable-app-data-preview
fixtures.source: constructed — buildAnnounceFrame(false, false, app_data="nomadnet.node", hops=2) construction rules from test/reticulum_announce/test_reticulum_announce.cpp, with the app_data ramp replaced by printable ASCII. The C++ never inspects app_data bytes; the browser offers a printable-ASCII preview only, labelled as a preview, because RNS app_data is usually msgpack
